bugs.description: Invoice approval checks the role but no longer verifies that the invoice belongs to the session tenant, so an approver can approve another tenant's invoice.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A billing approver knows or receives an invoice object whose tenantId differs from the authenticated session tenantId.
bugs.observableImpact: A cross-tenant invoice is approved despite the tenant isolation boundary.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base implementation whose approval predicate required both tenant equality and the billing-approver role. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.
